10th Value Investing Pioneers Summit

“If I have seen further, it is by standing on the shoulders of giants.” — Isaac Newton

Investing is a journey where experience compounds—not only through our own successes and failures, but also through the wisdom of those who have travelled the path before us. Every generation of investors inherits knowledge shaped by decades of market cycles, business successes, mistakes, changing assumptions and hard-earned lessons. Learning from that accumulated experience is one of the most powerful forms of vicarious learning.

The Value Investing Pioneers Summit (VIPS) was conceived around this idea: that we can accelerate our own journey by listening to those who have already navigated parts of the road we are yet to travel.

VIPS brings together investors and practitioners who have lived through multiple market cycles and experienced both the rewards and setbacks of investing. They share not just what worked, but what didn’t; not only their convictions, but their doubts; not just their successes, but their mistakes—and the moments when deeply held frameworks had to evolve.

The Summit is a forum for curiosity, reflection and intellectual exchange—a space to challenge conventional wisdom, examine our assumptions and learn from the accumulated experience of others.

Because in investing, knowing more is valuable. But learning how to think better may be even more so.

Join us at VIPS for a day of ideas, experiences and conversations that may leave you with fewer answers—but better questions.

Prof. Sanjay Bakshi

Adjunct Professor of Finance @ Flame University

Sanjay Bakshi is a Distinguished Adjunct Professor of Finance at Flame University in Pune, where he teaches behavioral economics and business and investment analysis to undergraduate students and experienced investors in executive programs. Previously, he was an Adjunct Professor at Management Development Institute, Gurgaon, where he taught behavioral finance and business valuation for 21 years. He is also a Managing Partner at ValueQuest Capital LLP, a SEBI-registered investment adviser that advises its onshore and offshore clients on their public-market investments in India. The firm is also the investment manager of an Alternative Investment Fund. Sanjay has been advising family offices on their public market investments for 32 years. Sanjay received an M.Sc. (Economics) from the London School of Economics and Political Science and a B.Com. (Hons.) from the University of Delhi. He is also a Fellow member of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India. He is 60 years old and lives in New Delhi.
